title: List Decoding, Linear Hashing, and Furstenberg over $\mathbb{F}_q$
summary: We give new bounds for list sizes of random linear codes at capacity, max loads of linear hash functions, and Furstenberg sets, over every finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$. 1. Random linear codes over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with rate $1 - H_q(p) - ε$ are $(p, O(q H_q(p)/ε))$-list decodable with high probability for all values of $p, q, ε$, including the high error regime. This nearly matches the list size lower bound of $H_q(p)/ε$ due to Guruswami, Li, Mosheiff, Resch, Silas, and Wootters [IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 2022].
